name: Beef Shirataki
instructions: Place the noodles in a saucepan of boiling water and cook for 1 minute , separating the noodles with chopsticks
Drain and cut into 10 cm lengths
Bring the sauce , sugar and mirin to a boil in a medium saucepan
Add the beef and cook just until the meat changes colour
Strain the beef over a heatproof bowl and return the sauce to the same saucepan
Add the onions and noodles to the pan and simmer for 3 minutes or until the onion softens
Return the beef , add the ginger juice and heat through
Divide the rice among serving bowls
Top with beef and noodles and about 1 / 4 cup of the sauce
